name: JAC Absorption: AI Ashina into AI Date on Japan 15 km; every asset, native religion, same-turn and post-AI-turn save/load

steps.code:
local A=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption,'absorption mod not loaded'); local R=A.Rules
local from,to
for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do
  local name=PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()
  if name=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA' then from=p:GetID() elseif name=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_DATE' then to=p:GetID() end
end
assert(from and to and not Players[from]:IsHuman() and not Players[to]:IsHuman(),'need two AI houses')
assert(Players[from]:GetCities():GetCount()>=2,'Ashina must have two cities')
assert(#PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()==22,'expected Japan map with 22 houses')
local cap=Players[from]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); local x,y=cap:GetX(),cap:GetY()
local function newlyCreated(create,kind)
  local before={};for _,u in Players[from]:GetUnits():Members() do before[u:GetID()]=true end
  create()
  local result
  for _,u in Players[from]:GetUnits():Members() do
    if not before[u:GetID()] and GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].UnitType==kind then assert(not result,'multiple new test units');result=u end
  end
  assert(result,'no new test '..kind);return result
end
local hero=newlyCreated(function() UnitManager.InitUnitValidAdjacentHex(from,'UNIT_WARRIOR',x,y,8) end,'UNIT_WARRIOR')
local person=newlyCreated(function() UnitManager.InitUnitValidAdjacentHex(from,'UNIT_WARRIOR',x,y,8) end,'UNIT_WARRIOR')
local individual
for row in GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals() do
  if row.GreatPersonClassType=='GREAT_PERSON_CLASS_GENERAL' and (not individual or row.Index<individual.Index) then individual=row end
end
assert(individual,'no native general individual in database')
local great=newlyCreated(function() Game.GetGreatPeople():CreatePerson(from,individual.Index,x,y) end,'UNIT_GREAT_GENERAL')
assert(great:GetGreatPerson():GetIndividual()==individual.Index,'CreatePerson individual mismatch')
local native=assert(GameInfo.Religions['RELIGION_CUSTOM_1'],'native test religion missing')
assert(Players[from]:GetReligion():GetReligionTypeCreated()<0,'unexpected founded religion at Japan start')
Game.GetReligion():FoundReligion(from,native.Index)
assert(Players[from]:GetReligion():GetReligionTypeCreated()==native.Index,'FoundReligion failed')
for _,city in Players[from]:GetCities():Members() do city:GetReligion():AddReligiousPressure(0,native.Index,10000,from) end
assert((A.CityReligion(cap)[tostring(native.Index)] or 0)>0,'native believers were not seeded')
local priest=newlyCreated(function() UnitManager.InitUnitValidAdjacentHex(from,'UNIT_MISSIONARY',x,y,8) end,'UNIT_MISSIONARY')
priest:GetReligion():SetReligionType(native.ReligionType)
hero:SetProperty(R.PERSON_KEY,{ID='live:hero',Kind='HERO',Owner=from,Unit={Owner=from,ID=hero:GetID()},Contract='PROTECT',Loyalty=73,Lifespan=19,Relations={friend=25}})
person:SetProperty(R.PERSON_KEY,{ID='live:person',Kind='PERSON',Owner=from,Unit={Owner=from,ID=person:GetID()},Level=6,XP=17,Personality='LOYAL',Trait='DEVOUT',Equipment={'ARMOR'}})
person:SetProperty('JAC_POC_GROWTHUI_WARLORD',{Level=6,XP=17,Personality='LOYAL',Trait='DEVOUT',Equipment={'ARMOR'},Artifact='live:artifact'})
person:SetDamage(17);person:ChangeMovesRemaining(-1)
local roster={
 ['live:hero']=hero:GetProperty(R.PERSON_KEY),['live:person']=person:GetProperty(R.PERSON_KEY),
 ['live:equipment']={ID='live:equipment',Kind='ITEM',Owner=from,Type='EQUIPMENT',Anchor={Kind='PERSON',ID='live:person'}},
 ['live:artifact']={ID='live:artifact',Kind='ITEM',Owner=from,Type='ARTIFACT',Anchor={Kind='VAULT',ID='live:vault'}},
 ['live:collection']={ID='live:collection',Kind='ITEM',Owner=from,Type='COLLECTION',City={Owner=from,X=x,Y=y}},
 ['live:religion']={ID='live:religion',Kind='RELIGION',Owner=from,ReligionID='POC_SECT',Founder=from,State='PUBLIC',Followers=9,
   HolySites={{X=x,Y=y}},Clergy={'live:priest'},Scriptures={'live:scripture'},Relics={'live:artifact'},Sects={'POC_SECT'}},
 ['live:unlock']={ID='live:unlock',Kind='UNLOCK',Owner=from,Jobs={'POC_MONK'},Document='live:scripture'}
}
Players[from]:SetProperty(R.ROSTER_KEY,roster)
Players[to]:SetProperty(R.ROSTER_KEY,{
 ['live:existing']={ID='live:existing',Kind='ITEM',Owner=to,Type='EQUIPMENT'},
 ['live:other-community']={ID='live:other-community',Kind='RELIGION',Owner=to,ReligionID='POC_SECT',Founder=from,State='UNDERGROUND',Followers=2}})
cap:SetProperty(R.CITY_FAITH_KEY,{ReligionID='POC_SECT',Followers=4,HolySite=true,Clergy={'live:priest'},Scriptures={'live:scripture'},Relics={'live:artifact'},State='PUBLIC'})
A.RegisterUnitProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_BELONGINGS')
priest:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_BELONGINGS',{Scripture='live:scripture',Relic='live:artifact'})
local plan={ID='japan-live-absorption',From=from,To=to,Mode='MERGER',EntryConditionsMet=true,RelationsResolved=true,Leader='RECRUIT',Units={},Assets={}}
local expected={From=from,To=to,Individual=individual.Index,Religion=native.Index,SourceRoster=A.GetRoster(from),TargetRoster=A.GetRoster(to),
 Units={},Cities={},Plots={},OriginalToCities=Players[to]:GetCities():GetCount(),OriginalToUnits=Players[to]:GetUnits():GetCount()}
for _,u in Players[from]:GetUnits():Members() do
  local snap=A.SnapshotUnit(u);expected.Units[#expected.Units+1]=snap
  plan.Units[R.UnitKey(from,u:GetID())]=snap.Kind=='UNIT' and 'INCORPORATE' or snap.Kind=='HERO' and 'PROTECT' or 'RECRUIT'
end
for id,asset in pairs(roster) do plan.Assets[id]=asset.Kind=='HERO' and 'PROTECT' or asset.Kind=='PERSON' and 'RECRUIT' or asset.Kind=='RELIGION' and 'PRESERVE' or asset.Kind=='UNLOCK' and 'INHERIT' or 'TRANSFER' end
for _,c in Players[from]:GetCities():Members() do
  expected.Cities[#expected.Cities+1]={X=c:GetX(),Y=c:GetY(),Population=c:GetPopulation(),Faith=A.CityReligion(c),Assets=A.CityAssets(c),PalaceWorks=A.PalaceWorks(c),Property=c:GetProperty(R.CITY_FAITH_KEY)}
end
for i=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do if Map.GetPlotByIndex(i):GetOwner()==from then expected.Plots[#expected.Plots+1]=i end end
assert(#expected.Units>=4 and #expected.Plots>0,'empty source fixtures')
local nativeDefinition
for _,row in ipairs(Game.GetReligion():GetReligions()) do if row.Religion==native.Index then nativeDefinition={Religion=row.Religion,Founder=row.Founder,Beliefs=R.Copy(row.Beliefs or {})} end end
assert(nativeDefinition and nativeDefinition.Founder==from,'native religion definition not created')
expected.NativeDefinition=nativeDefinition
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_EXPECT_V1',expected)
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_PLAN_V1',plan)
return 'seeded two AI houses, native general and religion, people/Hero/three belongings, holy site/clergy/scripture/relic/sect/job'

local A=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption);local tx=A.Apply(assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_PLAN_V1')));assert(tx.Status=='COMPLETE','absorption incomplete');return 'AI Ashina absorbed into AI Date'

local A=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption);local R=A.Rules
A.RegisterUnitProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_BELONGINGS')
local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_EXPECT_V1'));local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_PLAN_V1'))
local nativeDefinition
for _,row in ipairs(Game.GetReligion():GetReligions()) do if row.Religion==e.Religion then nativeDefinition={Religion=row.Religion,Founder=row.Founder,Beliefs=R.Copy(row.Beliefs or {})} end end
assert(nativeDefinition and nativeDefinition.Founder==e.From,'native religion identity/founder lost')
A.Verify(plan.ID,true)
assert(A.Canonical(nativeDefinition)==A.Canonical(e.NativeDefinition),'native religion beliefs changed')
assert(Players[e.To]:GetCities():GetCount()==e.OriginalToCities+#e.Cities,'destination city count')
assert(Players[e.To]:GetUnits():GetCount()==e.OriginalToUnits+#e.Units+1,'destination unit count including leader proxy')
local function same(a,b,what) assert(A.Canonical(a)==A.Canonical(b),what) end
for _,old in ipairs(e.Units) do
  local u=assert(A.FindUnit(e.To,plan.ID..':unit:'..old.ID),'missing transferred old unit '..old.ID)
  assert(GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].UnitType==old.Type,'unit type changed')
  local gp=u:GetGreatPerson();assert((gp and gp:GetIndividual() or -1)==old.Individual,'native individual changed')
  assert(u:GetDamage()==old.Damage and u:GetMovesRemaining()==old.Moves,'damage or moves changed')
  assert(u:GetBuildCharges()==old.BuildCharges and u:GetSpreadCharges()==old.SpreadCharges,'charges changed')
  assert(u:GetExperience():GetExperiencePoints()==old.XP,'experience changed')
  for key,value in pairs(old.Properties) do if key~=R.PERSON_KEY then same(u:GetProperty(key),value,'transferred unit property '..key) end end
end
for _,old in ipairs(e.Cities) do
  local c=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(old.X,old.Y));assert(c:GetOwner()==e.To and c:GetPopulation()==old.Population,'city moved incorrectly')
  for _,work in ipairs(old.PalaceWorks) do assert(A.OwnedGreatWorks(e.To)[work],'Palace work lost') end
  same(A.CityReligion(c),old.Faith,'native followers changed');same(A.CityAssets(c),old.Assets,'buildings/Great Works changed')
  same(c:GetProperty(R.CITY_FAITH_KEY),old.Property,'holy site and clergy data changed')
end
for _,i in ipairs(e.Plots) do assert(Map.GetPlotByIndex(i):GetOwner()==e.To,'old territory lost: '..i) end
local roster=A.GetRoster(e.To)
for id,old in pairs(e.SourceRoster) do
  local new=assert(roster[id],'missing asset '..id);assert(new.Owner==e.To,'asset owner '..id)
  for key,value in pairs(old) do if key~='Owner' and key~='Unit' and key~='City' then same(new[key],value,'asset field '..id..'.'..key) end end
  if old.Unit then assert(new.Unit.Owner==e.To and A.FindUnit(e.To,new.Unit.Token):GetID()==new.Unit.ID,'person/Hero reference') end
  if old.City then assert(new.City.Owner==e.To and new.City.X==old.City.X and new.City.Y==old.City.Y,'collection city reference') end
end
for id,old in pairs(e.TargetRoster) do same(roster[id],old,'pre-existing asset overwritten') end
assert(roster['live:hero'].Lifespan==19 and roster['live:hero'].Loyalty==73 and roster['live:hero'].Relations.friend==25,'Hero attributes changed')
assert(roster['live:person'].Level==6 and roster['live:person'].XP==17 and roster['live:person'].Personality=='LOYAL','person growth changed')
assert(roster['live:equipment'].Anchor.ID=='live:person' and roster['live:artifact'].Anchor.ID=='live:vault','belongings detached')
assert(roster['live:religion'].Founder==e.From and roster['live:religion'].Followers==9 and roster['live:religion'].State=='PUBLIC','religion identity changed')
assert(roster['live:other-community'].Followers==2 and roster['live:other-community'].State=='UNDERGROUND','same sect community overwritten')
local leader=assert(roster['leader:'..e.From]);assert(leader.Persistent and leader.Unit.Owner==e.To,'former leader lost')
local saved=A.Canonical(A.GetState());A.Apply(plan);assert(A.Canonical(A.GetState())==saved,'same request replayed')
local actual={State=A.GetState(),Roster=roster,SourceRoster=A.GetRoster(e.From),Units={},Cities={},Plots={}}
for _,old in ipairs(e.Units) do local u=A.FindUnit(e.To,plan.ID..':unit:'..old.ID);actual.Units[#actual.Units+1]=A.SnapshotUnit(u) end
actual.Leader=A.SnapshotUnit(A.FindUnit(e.To,plan.ID..':leader'))
for _,old in ipairs(e.Cities) do local c=CityManager.GetCityAt(old.X,old.Y);actual.Cities[#actual.Cities+1]={Owner=c:GetOwner(),Population=c:GetPopulation(),Faith=A.CityReligion(c),Assets=A.CityAssets(c),Governance=c:GetProperty(R.GOVERNANCE_KEY),FaithProperty=c:GetProperty(R.CITY_FAITH_KEY)} end
for _,i in ipairs(e.Plots) do actual.Plots[i]=Map.GetPlotByIndex(i):GetOwner() end
local transferred={Roster=R.Copy(roster),Properties={}}
for _,old in ipairs(e.Units) do transferred.Properties[tostring(old.ID)]=R.Copy(A.SnapshotUnit(A.FindUnit(e.To,plan.ID..':unit:'..old.ID)).Properties) end
transferred.Properties.leader=R.Copy(actual.Leader.Properties)
local existing=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_TRANSFERRED_V1')
if existing then assert(A.Canonical(existing)==A.Canonical(transferred),'transferred invariants changed after reload') else Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_TRANSFERRED_V1',transferred) end
actual.NativeDefinition=nativeDefinition
return A.Canonical(actual)

local A=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption);local R=A.Rules
A.RegisterUnitProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_BELONGINGS')
local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_EXPECT_V1'));local plan=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_PLAN_V1')
local nativeDefinition
for _,row in ipairs(Game.GetReligion():GetReligions()) do if row.Religion==e.Religion then nativeDefinition={Religion=row.Religion,Founder=row.Founder,Beliefs=R.Copy(row.Beliefs or {})} end end
assert(nativeDefinition and nativeDefinition.Founder==e.From,'native religion identity/founder lost')
local tx=A.GetState().Transactions[plan.ID];assert(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()>tx.Turn,'AI turn did not advance')
assert(Players[e.From]:GetCities():GetCount()==0 and Players[e.From]:GetUnits():GetCount()==0,'donor regained an engine asset')
assert(next(A.GetRoster(e.From))==nil,'donor roster regained an asset')
local transferred=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_TRANSFERRED_V1'),'no immediate invariants')
local actual={State=A.GetState(),Roster=A.GetRoster(e.To),Units={},Cities={},Plots={}}
for id,expected in pairs(transferred.Roster) do
 local record=assert(actual.Roster[id],'persistent asset lost after AI turn: '..id)
 assert(record.Owner==e.To and record.ID==id,'persistent asset ownership after AI turn: '..id)
 assert(A.Canonical(record)==A.Canonical(expected),'persistent asset changed after AI turn: '..id)
end
for _,old in ipairs(e.Units) do
 local u=assert(A.FindUnit(e.To,plan.ID..':unit:'..old.ID),'transferred unit lost after AI turn')
 assert(u:GetOwner()==e.To and GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].UnitType==old.Type,'unit owner/type after AI turn')
 local gp=u:GetGreatPerson();assert((gp and gp:GetIndividual() or -1)==old.Individual,'native general identity after AI turn')
 local snap=A.SnapshotUnit(u)
 assert(A.Canonical(snap.Properties)==A.Canonical(transferred.Properties[tostring(old.ID)]),'transferred unit properties changed after AI turn: '..old.ID)
 actual.Units[#actual.Units+1]=snap
end
actual.Leader=A.SnapshotUnit(assert(A.FindUnit(e.To,plan.ID..':leader')))
assert(A.Canonical(actual.Leader.Properties)==A.Canonical(transferred.Properties.leader),'leader properties changed after AI turn')
for _,old in ipairs(e.Cities) do local c=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(old.X,old.Y));assert(c:GetOwner()==e.To,'city owner after AI turn');actual.Cities[#actual.Cities+1]={Owner=c:GetOwner(),Population=c:GetPopulation(),Faith=A.CityReligion(c),Assets=A.CityAssets(c),Governance=c:GetProperty(R.GOVERNANCE_KEY),FaithProperty=c:GetProperty(R.CITY_FAITH_KEY)} end
for _,old in ipairs(e.Cities) do for _,work in ipairs(old.PalaceWorks) do assert(A.OwnedGreatWorks(e.To)[work],'Palace work lost after AI turn') end end

assert(actual.Roster['live:hero'].Lifespan==19 and actual.Roster['live:religion'].Founder==e.From,'persistent Hero/religion data changed')
actual.NativeDefinition=nativeDefinition
return A.Canonical(actual)
